premises.statement: Whitespace splitting recovers the intended OMNI2 fields in the same column positions for every record in omni2_2024.dat.
premises.reason: The displayed shape and positional column inspections depend on consistent parsing, which a few inspected rows do not establish for the full file.

fewer.target: df and its printed shape and column inspections
fewer.reason: These steps only load and inspect the raw OMNI2 file; they do not yet identify an AP column, handle missing values, calculate orbital changes, or estimate correlations.
